content.title: ‘Invincible’ Season 4 Episode 5 – release date, schedule, how to watch
content.text: Mark is on a mission to protect his home and the people he loves in Season 4 of "Invincible," which premiered on Prime Video on March 18 with the first three episodes.Episode 4 aired on Prime Video on March 25, and next up is Episode 5, which will land on the streaming service at 12 a.m. PT/3 a.m. ET on April 1.Invincible (Steven Yeun) and Omni-Man (JK Simmons) in "Invincible" Season 4. | Courtesy of Prime'Invincible' Season 4 Episode 5 Release Date"Invincible" Season 4 Episode 5 will be available to stream on Prime Video on April 1, 2026.New episodes of "Invincible" Season 4 premiere on Prime Video each Wednesday through April 22, 2026.'Invincible' Season 4 Episode 5 – How to Watch"Invincible" Season 4 Episode 5 lands at 12 a.m. PT/3 a.m. ET on Prime Video on April 1, 2026.A Prime Video subscription is required to watch "Invincible" Season 4. Prime Video costs $14.99 per month or $139 annually when included with an Amazon Prime membership, or you can subscribe to the streaming service alone for $8.99 per month.What Time Does 'Invincible' Season 4 Episode 5 Come Out?"Invincible" Season 4 Episode 5 will be available on Prime Video from 12 a.m. PT/3 a.m. ET.With the early streaming release in the US, the debut time in other time zones will differ. Here is when "Invincible" Season 4 will air in different time zones:April 1BRT: 4:00 amBST: 8:00 amCEST: 9:00 amIST: 12:30 pmJST: 4:00 pmAET: 5:00 pmNZDT: 7:00 pmWill All Episodes of 'Invincible' Season 4 Land at Once?No. Season 4 of "Invincible" will launch with three episodes on March 18, followed by new episodes weekly through April 22.Will There Be More Than One Episode of 'Invincible' Season 4 This Week?No. New episodes will now debut on Prime Video weekly following the three-episode Season 4 premiere.'Invincible' Season 4 Release ScheduleEpisode 1: March 18Episode 2: March 18Episode 3: March 18Episode 4: March 25Episode 5: April 1Episode 6: April 8Episode 7: April 15Episode 8: April 22'Invincible' Season 4 Episode 5 RuntimeThere is no confirmed runtime for "Invincible" Season 4 Episode 5 yet. Previous episodes in this season have been between 49 and 53 minutes long.What Will Happen in 'Invincible' Season 4 Episode 5?The plot details for Episode 5 of "Invincible" Season 4 are currently under wraps.Previous episode synopses can be found below:Episode 1: Mark battles enemies new and old in his fight to keep Earth safe.Episode 2: TBCEpisode 3: Consequences weigh on Mark. Oliver takes on a new job.(as per IMDb)The Season 4 synopsis, as per Prime Video, reads, "While the world recovers from catastrophe, a changed Mark fights to protect his home and the people he loves, setting him on a collision course with a threat that could alter the fate of humanity forever."
